A container row declares a role at the end of its own words.

- a lesson above the side branch
	- If your notes are not all in English {sequence=local}
		- the side-branch lesson

A row that is only a declaration keeps it, because nothing else would be left.

- {sequence=local}
	- a child under a nameless container

A role quoted in code is text about the grammar, not a declaration.

- a row naming `{sequence=local}`
	- a child under a quoted marker
